commands.tomato: tomato build --mode release (clang -O2 -flto on the LLVM IR)
commands.tomato-debug: tomato build --mode debug (clang -O1 -flto on the LLVM IR)
commands.rust: rustc -O (bigint: cargo build --release with the num-bigint crate)
commands.rust-radix: rustc -O (sort_radix.rs: a radix sort instead of the standard sort)
commands.csharp: dotnet build -c Release, then dotnet FILE.dll
